# Statement of Work — Time & Materials (Agile)

> **Flavor:** Iterative, rate-card-driven engagement billed for time & materials
> against a not-to-exceed ceiling.
> **Best for:** Discovery-heavy or evolving scope, staff augmentation, agile delivery.
> **Maps to Kerdos:** labor lines (role × units × rate) → the team & rate table;
> grand total → the not-to-exceed; monthly recurring → run-rate. `{{…}}` merge.

## 1. Engagement Model

This is a **time-and-materials** engagement delivered in iterative sprints. The
Provider supplies the roles below at the stated rates; the Client directs priorities
through a shared backlog. Fees accrue against actual effort, capped at the
**not-to-exceed** amount in §6.

{{OVERVIEW}}

## 6. Budget & Not-to-Exceed

- **Monthly run-rate (recurring):** {{MONTHLY_TOTAL}}

## 7. Invoicing

Invoiced **monthly in arrears** for hours/days worked plus pass-through expenses,
with a timesheet/itemized summary. Net {{NET_TERMS}} days. {{PAYMENT_TERMS}}

## 8. Assumptions

{{ASSUMPTIONS}}

## 9. Change Control

Backlog re-prioritization within the ceiling needs no formal change order. Changes
to the **rates, roles, or not-to-exceed** are made by a written change note signed
by both parties. {{CHANGE_CONTROL}}

## 10. Acceptance

Work is reviewed at each sprint review; increments are accepted on Client sign-off
or 5 business days after demo if no issues are raised.
